{{Top|leg}}
'''Gen-6''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was produced during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], the [[Typha-Dor]]s loaned a Gen-6 to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in their hunt for the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] after they had helped to avert a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] invasion by the [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].
